status.en: 8 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 20% fewer than the week before, most of them in Mogadishu, Baidoa and Puntland.
status.nb: 8 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Mogadishu, Baidoa og Puntland.

summary.en: Al-Shabaab continues to test Kenya's border defenses with probe attacks, while militia violence near the Kenya-Ethiopia border killed eight people. Somali Danab commandos are conducting security operations along the Bay-Lower Shabelle border, and the Kenyan Defence Forces are preparing for chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear threats linked to al-Shabaab. Uganda has repeatedly denied reports that its troops were killed or attacked while withdrawing from Somalia. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Al-Shabaab fortsetter å teste Kenyas grenseforsvar med provoserende angrep, mens væpnede grupper ved Kenyas-Etiopia-grense drepte åtte personer. Somaliske Danab-kommandos utfører sikkerhetsoperasjoner langs Bay-Lower Shabelle-grensen, og Kenyas forsvarsstyrker forbereder seg på kjemiske, biologiske, radiologiske og nukleære trusler knyttet til al-Shabaab. Uganda har gjentatte ganger avvist rapporter om at deres soldater ble drept eller angrepet under tilbaketrekning fra Somalia. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Somali Civil War (2009–present)
background.extract: The ongoing phase of the Somali Civil War began in 2009 and is concentrated in southern and central Somalia, primarily between the forces of the Federal Government of Somalia (FGS), assisted by African Union peacekeeping forces, and the Islamist militant group al-Shabaab, which pledged allegiance to al-Qaeda in 2012.
